story.title: A failed relationship blocks the mart
story.objective: Diagnose the intended missing-key failure and prove repair.
story.audience: Instructor demonstration; completed instructor copy is explicitly identified
story.prerequisites: Prepared runtime and assigned disposable resources; authenticate outside recording

caption.notice: The independent CSV oracle agrees with all three fund results.

action.command:
cp seeds/holdings.csv holdings.saved.csv
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('seeds/holdings.csv'); p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('A,','UNKNOWN,',1))"
rm training.duckdb
cat seeds/holdings.csv

caption.action: Introduce one unmatched key in a fresh database.
caption.notice: The first holding now references UNKNOWN; an old mart cannot mask this attempt.
The relationship test fails; the dependent mart is skipped and absent.

action.command: cp holdings.saved.csv seeds/holdings.csv && dbt seed --profiles-dir . && dbt build --profiles-dir .

caption.action: Restore the original input and rebuild.
caption.notice: The repaired build and independently calculated fund outputs agree.
The same five holdings yield the same three per-fund results.

story.closing_question: Diagnose the intended missing-key failure and prove repair. Which observation supports your explanation?
